questions: Should the split position i be allowed to be 0 or N, resulting in an empty subarray, and if so, how is the count of distinct integers defined for an empty subarray?

If the same integer appears in both subarrays, does it contribute to the distinct count in each subarray independently, or is there any cross-subarray deduplication?
Is the split position i required to be an integer index between 1 and N-1, or can it be any integer in that range?
Should the output be a single integer representing the maximum sum, or is there any formatting (e.g., newline) required beyond printing the integer?
Are there any constraints on memory usage or time complexity that should be considered for implementation, beyond the given constraints?
